AboutPage.metaDescription: International Animal Welfare Research Network. Learn about our mission, objectives and research areas.
AboutPage.introTitle: An academic network committed to animal welfare
AboutPage.introSubtitle: Learn about our mission, objectives and research areas in animal welfare and food sustainability.

objective.title: Objective
objective.body: The International Animal Welfare Research Network (RED-RIIBA) has as its main objective to promote and coordinate research efforts at a global level to improve animal welfare in various production systems. Through interdisciplinary collaboration and knowledge exchange, we seek to develop innovative and sustainable solutions that contribute to animal health and welfare, as well as food security.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: Promote and coordinate research, training and international cooperation efforts to improve Animal Welfare in various production and coexistence systems, articulating interdisciplinary and sustainable solutions that contribute to animal health, biosecurity, sovereignty and food security under the "One Health – One Welfare" approach.

intention.title: Intention
intention.intro: The Network's intention is to create a collaborative environment in which researchers, academics, producers, legislators and other stakeholders can work together to:

diagnosticMethods.title: Develop advanced diagnostic methods
diagnosticMethods.body: improve tools and techniques for monitoring animal health, enabling accurate and rapid diagnoses.

naturalProducts.title: Promote the use of natural products
naturalProducts.body: research and validate natural alternatives for animal care and welfare, reducing dependence on synthetic products.

educationalPrograms.title: Implement educational programs
educationalPrograms.body: foster education and training in animal welfare, both for farm and companion animals, and discuss issues related to food safety.

sustainableProduction.title: Guarantee sustainable production
sustainableProduction.body: promote sustainable agricultural practices that improve food quality and safety.

geneticImprovement.title: Foster genetic improvement
geneticImprovement.body: create breeding stock resistant to gastric infections to improve animal health and productivity.

regulations.title: Establish clear and enforceable regulations
regulations.body: advocate for effective regulations that protect animal welfare and ensure the quality of food products.

AboutPage.areasSubtitle: Fifteen strategic areas that articulate applied research, training and advocacy in Animal Welfare public policies.

physiologicalDiagnosis.title: Physiological diagnostics
physiologicalDiagnosis.description: Development and use of advanced devices for the detection of gastrointestinal parasites and other animal health indicators.

animalHealth.title: Animal health and welfare
animalHealth.description: Use of natural products under the "One Health – One Welfare" approach for disease prevention and treatment.

nutritionEducation.title: Nutritional education
nutritionEducation.description: Development of educational programs on animal management and nutrition.

foodSustainability.title: Food sustainability
foodSustainability.description: Strategies to guarantee high-quality and safe food production.

geneticImprovement.title: Genetic improvement
geneticImprovement.description: Research for genetic improvement and creation of breeding stock resistant to gastric infections.

reproductionBiotech.title: Animal reproduction and biotechnology
reproductionBiotech.description: Advanced techniques to improve reproductive efficiency: artificial insemination, embryo transfer, cryopreservation and genetic selection.

computerEngineering.title: Applied computer engineering
computerEngineering.description: Digital solutions for the optimization of production systems, animal welfare and food sustainability.

waterManagement.title: Water management
waterManagement.description: Design and optimization of water supply and distribution systems for animals and aquaculture.

wastewaterManagement.title: Wastewater management
wastewaterManagement.description: Farm wastewater treatment systems to reduce pollution and protect water resources.

predictiveModels.title: Predictive models and data analysis
predictiveModels.description: Mathematical models and data analysis to predict diseases and optimize production.

resourceOptimization.title: Resource optimization
resourceOptimization.description: Algorithms for efficient resource management in animal production systems.

infrastructureDesign.title: Infrastructure design
infrastructureDesign.description: Planning of adequate facilities for animal housing and handling with optimal welfare conditions.

sustainableConstruction.title: Sustainable construction
sustainableConstruction.description: Ecological materials and techniques compatible with the development of animal production infrastructure.

socialImpact.title: Social and cultural impact
socialImpact.description: Studies on how inadequate animal welfare practices affect local communities and their economy.

legislation.title: Legislation and policies
legislation.description: Research and promotion of laws and policies that improve animal welfare.
